sentences.text:
Smt Sweta Jain vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 May, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 4735 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt Sweta Jain

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

This application under Section 482 CrPC has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash the order dated 09.01.2024 in Case No. 857 of 2019 under Section 125 Cr.P.C, Police Station Hastinapur, District Meerut pending in the Court learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut.

Further, it is prayed to direct the learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut to reconsider the interim maintenance application and further direct to consider and decide the Case No. 857 of 2019,
under Section 125 Cr.P.C, Police Station Hastinapur, District Meerut, pending before the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that interim maintenance application of the applicant was rejected by the Court concerned merely on the basis that complaint filed by the applicant under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 342, 327 I.P.C has been dismissed under Section 203 Cr.P.C.

The learned trial Court while deciding the interim maintenance application vide order dated 09.01.2024, concluded that the complaint of the applicant was dismissed under Section 203 Cr.P.C Smt Sweta Jain vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71691549/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: as without any reasonable cause, she was living separately from opposite party no. 2.

The learned trial Court did not follow the guidelines laid down by Hon'ble the Apex Court in Rajnesh Vs. Neha and another, (2021) 2 SCC 324, and without considering the status of the parties, income of the parties as well as the capacity and hardship, if any, faced by the applicant.

entities.text: Rajnesh Vs. Neha and another, (2021) 2 SCC 324
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, learned AGA has opposed the prayer made by the applicant.

5. Perusal of the record goes to show that application for interim maintenance was dismissed merely on the basis that complaint filed by the applicant under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 342, 327 I.P.C has been dismissed under Section 203 Cr.P.C.

The learned trial Court did not discussed the status of the parties, income of the parties, hardship, if any, faced by the applicant and the ingredients of Section 125 Cr.P.C while passing the impugned order.
6.

Since, on the face of record, the impugned order passed by the Court concerned appears to be contrary to the provisions contained under Section 125 Cr.P.C, therefore, there is no requirement to issue notice to opposite party no. 2.
7.

8. The impugned order dated 09.01.2024 passed in Case No. 857 of 2019 under Section 125 Cr.P.C,
Police Station Hastinapur, District Meerut pending in the Court learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut is hereby set aside Order Date :- 15.5.2024 PS  Smt Sweta Jain vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71691549/
2
